Sapphire Wire is a Hunter-exclusive material that can be found in Destiny. It is acquired from dismantling uncommon or higher Hunter armor. Sapphire Wire is used to upgrade rare or higher Hunter armor. After the release of The Taken King, these materials were no longer used and were replaced by Armor Materials. Guardians' existing Sapphire Wire can be traded for Armor Materials by Roni 55-30.

Relic Iron is a material that is used to upgrade weapons and armor in Destiny. Relic Iron can be harvested from Relic Shards, which appear randomly in some areas on Mars. Relic Iron may also be awarded to players for opening loot chests on Mars, turning in Patrol or Queen's Wrath bounties, or opening Judgment's Grant packages. They can be purchased from the Vanguard Quartermaster for Legendary Marks at a rate of 10 Marks for 20 Relic Iron. Once obtained, Relic Iron is stored in a player's inventory. 200 Relic Iron can be stored in a single stack, after which point a new stack is started.

Silver Dollar Mk.35 is a shotgun used by Guardians. The weapon is built on a sturdy frame that can accommodate a number of variations of attachments and accessories, but the Silver Dollar Mk.35 comes with a catcher and a four-cartridge sidecar. Its paint scheme seems to imply that "it has seen action near the evacuation site for the last colony ships that escaped the collapse." This weapon has been shown only in screenshots and described briefly in an article on Bungie's official website. Despite having been removed from the final game, it is still present on the Shotguns Grimiore card.
Lord Shaxx is the Crucible Handler located in the Tower. He sells a variety of high-level armor to Guardians. He also serves as the announcer during Crucible matches.
Shingen-D was a rare auto rifle in the Destiny First Look Alpha. It was removed from the final game.
